name: @loom/plugin-a2ui
description: A2UI egress adapter — projects Loom agent surfaces onto the Google A2UI (Agent-to-UI) wire protocol v1.0 (createSurface / updateDataModel / deleteSurface) so any A2UI-compliant client can render a Loom-driven UI. Egress + inbound actions only; bidirectional RPC (callFunction/actionResponse) is out of scope by design.
